title: HubEgo-100K: In-the-Wild Egocentric Video of Skilled Work for Robot Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.21938v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot policies trained by imitation generalize poorly outside the environments and objects seen in training. Published data-scaling studies find that generalization grows with the diversity of training environments and objects rather than with more demonstrations per environment. Robot data is costly to collect across many environments, whereas egocentric human video can be recorded in the wild at scale; existing egocentric video, however, mostly shows daily-life activity and contains little skilled work in real workplaces. We present HubEgo-100K, a dataset built for diversity. This version of the paper covers the first release, v1.0: 10,124 hours of 1080p egocentric video with synchronized 100 Hz inertial (IMU) data from one head-mounted phone camera. In v1.0, 12,227 contributors record their own unscripted work in 15,548 environments (each one contributor's own setting of one type, such as their kitchen or workshop) across 11 setting

translated_title: HubEgo-100K：用于机器人学习的真实场景下熟练工作的自我中心视角视频数据集
translated_abstract: 通过模仿学习训练的机器人策略在训练中未见过的环境和物体之外泛化能力较差。已发表的数据规模研究表明，泛化能力随训练环境和物体的多样性提升而增长，而非随每个环境中更多示范而增长。跨众多环境收集机器人数据成本高昂，而自我中心视角的人类视频可以在真实场景中大规模录制；然而，现有的自我中心视频大多展示日常生活活动，几乎不包含真实工作场所中的熟练工作。我们提出了 HubEgo-100K，一个为多样性而构建的数据集。本文的此版本涵盖首次发布 v1.0：10,124 小时的 1080p 自我中心视角视频，并配有来自一个头戴式手机摄像头的同步 100 Hz 惯性（IMU）数据。在 v1.0 中，12,227 名贡献者在 15,548 个环境中录制了他们自己未经编排的真实工作，涵盖 11 种场景类型（每个环境为某位贡献者自己某一类型的具体场所，例如其厨房或工坊）……
tldr: HubEgo-100K 是一个包含 10,124 小时视频的数据集，由 12,227 名贡献者在 15,548 个真实环境中录制熟练的未经编排工作，旨在通过环境和物体的多样性提升机器人模仿学习的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: HubEgo-100K is a 10,124-hour egocentric video dataset of skilled, unscripted work recorded by 12,227 contributors across 15,548 real-world environments, built to improve robot imitation-learning generalization through environment and object diversity.
